input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 玩在墓地里：在墓地里玩，A location phrase with 在 should come before the main verb 玩.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，装 cannot directly introduce an action in this meaning; 假装 means “pretend to” and can be followed by an action.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟妈妈搬家：孟子的妈妈带着他搬家，跟妈妈搬家 means that Mengzi moved together with his mother, but the intended meaning is that his mother took him when she moved; use 带着孟子/他搬家.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和他的朋友，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence: Mengzi was named in the immediately preceding sentence, and no competing male character makes 他 unclear.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子五岁的时候：他五岁的时候，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence of the same character.
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬家：搬了家，Use 了 for the completed move in this past narrative event.

items.reason: 地点短语应放在动词“玩”前面。
“装”不能这样直接搭配动作，“假装祭拜”可以正确表达该意思。
“跟妈妈搬家”可以自然表示孟子和妈妈一起搬家，原文并无此处所说的错误，且改后仍缺少完成体“了”。
孟子刚在前一句出现，且没有其他男性角色，应用“他”避免近距离重复名字。
同一角色在近距离再次出现时应使用“他”。
这里叙述的是五岁时已经完成的一次搬家，应说“搬了家”。
